scenes.title: The Problem
scenes.text: A neural network is a system that learns from examples. Given an input, it produces a prediction.

scenes.title: The Network
scenes.text: Information flows forward through layers of connected nodes, each applying a simple transformation.

scenes.title: Learning
scenes.text: The network compares its prediction to the correct answer. The difference — the loss — tells it how to adjust every weight.

scenes.title: Improvement
scenes.text: Repeat this across many examples, and the loss falls. The network learns.
